'''Tavah Whey Term''' was an [[Uyter/Legends|Uyterran]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] for the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lexi Dio/Legends|Lexi Dio]]. Alongside Dio and her other advisors, [[Mages Jink]], [[Benet Pryer]], and [[Half'pelt Sen]], Term brought to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] a healthy distain for centralization of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Uyter.<ref name="FF130" />
